findings.correction: the spearhead that had been slowly getting pushed back was sliced off like tofu.
findings.current: the spear tip that had been slowly pushing me back was sliced off like tofu.
findings.defect: 밀리고 있던 means the spearhead was being forced back; the draft makes it the agent pushing the narrator.
findings.rationale: The bind already has Taekyung losing the press; 밀리다 is passive. Reversing it contradicts the preceding ‘why is it coming up’ beat.
findings.source: 서서히 밀리고 있던 창두가 두부처럼 잘려 나갔다.

findings.correction: I had already flung myself sideways at the same moment I threw it.
findings.current: I had already thrown myself sideways along with the iron rod.
findings.defect: The throw is at the Head Elder; the body goes sideways at the same time. ‘Along with the iron rod’ makes them share one path.
findings.rationale: 투척과 동시에 옆으로 is simultaneous split motion: projectile forward, body aside to grab the fallen man.
findings.source: 이미 투척과 동시에 옆으로 몸을 날린 후였다.

findings.defect: The broken line is only ‘(to) my brother…’; the draft invents the later 손 떼 command and duplicates the next shout.
findings.rationale: 우리 형한테 is an incomplete dative fragment. 손 떼, 이 새끼야 comes only after he pulls the planted spear.

findings.correction: Through that clear view, I could see a white-haired old man.
findings.current: Beyond my clear field of vision, I saw a white-haired old man.
findings.defect: ‘Beyond my field of vision’ means he cannot see the man; the source is a clear view across the distance.
findings.rationale: 또렷한 시야 너머로 marks seeing the Head Elder clearly, which sets up spotting the body and blood at his feet.
findings.source: 또렷한 시야 너머로 백발의 노인이 보인다.

findings.correction:
This was a moment when even a meat shield—no, a single extra hand—was precious.

Besides, apart from me, Hyuk was the strongest meat shield in the reconnaissance squad. Ah, I kept saying it wrong.
findings.current:
This was a moment when every extra hand mattered. Every meat shie—damn it, I kept saying the wrong thing.

Besides, apart from me, Hyuk was the strongest meat shield in the reconnaissance squad. No, there I went again.
findings.defect: First beat corrects meat shield → extra hand; the draft starts from extra hand and slips into meat shield, and it moves 말이 자꾸 헛나오네 up a paragraph.
findings.rationale: The gag is failing to stop calling him a meat shield. Reversing the first correction and relocating the slip flattens that hierarchy of insult.
findings.source:
지금은 고기 방패, 아니 손 하나가 아쉬운 시점이다.

더군다나 혁무진은 나를 제외하면 정찰조 중 최고의 실력을 지닌 고기 방패, 아 말이 자꾸 헛나오네.

findings.correction: When we closed to within about a hundred feet of the Head Elder
findings.current: When we closed to within a dozen yards of the Head Elder
findings.defect: 십여 장 is about ten jang (~30 m / ~100 ft). A dozen yards (~11 m) nearly collapses into the later 삼 장 / thirty feet.
findings.rationale: The draft already renders 일 장 as ten feet and 삼 장 as thirty feet. 십여 장 must stay an order of magnitude larger or the approach distances stop shrinking.
findings.source: 대장로와의 거리가 십여 장 안으로 좁혀졌을 때

findings.correction: After a fast, heavy burst of vomiting, Hyuk
findings.current: After finishing his short, forceful bout of vomiting, Hyuk
findings.defect: 빠르고 굵은 describes a fast, heavy stream, not a short bout.
findings.rationale: 굵은 is volume/thickness; short is not in the source.

findings.defect: 좀 같이…… is an unfinished ‘together…’; ‘we should probably’ supplies a speech the source leaves incomplete.
findings.rationale: The interrupt is the sight of the battlefield cutting off a request to join, not a hedged plan.

summary: One reversed bind on the spearhead, plus several altered actions, invented/completed dialogue, a broken 장 scale, and a reversed meat-shield self-correction.
